dedupe_keys.name: eobuildings vector extension of the inria aerial image labeling building dataset

description: EOBuildings is an effort to reproduce, improve and extend the INRIA Aerial Image Labeling benchmark, a widely used dataset for detecting and segmenting buildings in aerial imagery. It was published on Zenodo on 8 August 2023 by Nicolas David of IGN, the French national mapping agency. The original INRIA benchmark released footprints only as rasters and only for its five training areas, researchers noted annotation quality problems, and later papers stopped using its hidden test set. Version 0.1 of EOBuildings therefore provides vector footprints for all ten INRIA areas of interest, plus two footprint sets for 28 square kilometres of the Jura department in France: one from national open building data and one annotated by hand from aerial orthoimagery. Coverage: the ten INRIA cities and the Jura test area. Access: shapefiles, openly downloadable from Zenodo; imagery comes from the original benchmark. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: an early version of an ongoing effort. Simulation uses are training and fairly testing building extraction models that populate exposure datasets. Related records: the Duke aerial imagery dataset and the IEEE GRSS DFC23 benchmark.
